title: World Acceptance Corporation Names John L. Calmes Jr. President and Chief Executive Officer
summary: GREENVILLE, S.C., September 21, 2026--World Acceptance Corporation (NASDAQ: WRLD) ("World Acceptance" or "the Company") today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed John L. Calmes Jr. as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective September 21, 2026. Mr. Calmes most recently served as the Company's Executive Vice President, Chief Financial and Strategy Officer, and Treasurer.
